plan.coverage_explanation: Exercises invalid startup temperature, alternating pages, strict threshold equality, separate and simultaneous alarm reasons, removal of individual reasons, invalid echo handling, recovery, and passive-buzzer carrier activity. Numeric displays allow the specified ±1 quantization tolerance. Recovery carrier activity is checked over a window rather than assuming an injection-anchored alarm phase. The suite does not establish exact buzzer envelope timing or phase preservation, sampling-start intervals, echo timeout arguments, serial baud, page-switch deadlines, or every new-reading response deadline. Distance validity endpoints, fractional thresholds, and temperature failure during an active alarm are not covered.
assumptions: The authoritative final serial baud assignment of 9600 overrides the earlier 115200 statement.
No generic LED/button bench defaults are needed; the supplied explicit wiring identifies all tested devices.
A null temperature injection represents a failed DHT reading; a null distance injection represents no echo.
Temperature checks allow acquisition at the next scheduled DHT sample rather than requiring immediate acquisition at injection time.
Blank TM1637 output is represented by four blank characters.
The recovery carrier edge check intentionally permits sampling, response, and envelope-edge uncertainty; it does not establish the precise 500ms ON/500ms OFF envelope.
